scenes.display: A jellybean rolls out of a jar.
scenes.tts: At breakfast, one brave jellybean rolled out of the jar. It shouted, I am free!
It bounced onto a spoon and declared, I am mayor of the kitchen! The spoon immediately resigned.

scenes.display: The jellybean gets stuck in a teacup.
scenes.tts: Then it fell into a teacup. A friend pulled it out, and the jellybean shared its tiny hat. Everyone cheered for Mayor Bean.
